sentence: This project provides biostatistical, mathematical and computational biology support to cancer research so that studies are designed efficiently and results are valid and reproducible.
This project combines protein engineering and machine learning to build protein inhibitors that selectively block specific protein targets in the extracellular matrix.
This project studies large patient cohorts and functional datasets to find out which mutations in ion channel genes are linked to disease.
This project studies how an enzyme in macrophages that controls one-carbon metabolism affects efferocytosis and the stability of atherosclerotic plaques.
This project tries to build targeted polymeric nanoparticles that carry carboplatin and paclitaxel to treat triple-negative breast cancer.
This project develops a neuroimaging tool for cochlear implant users to study how their brains process speech.
This project studies how the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator works and looks for inhibitors to help treat polycystic kidney disease.
This project studies why women with early-onset type 2 diabetes have higher cardiovascular disease risk than men.
This project studies how cells measure and respond to different levels of oxidative stress and how stress response pathways are coordinated.
This project builds a core service that offers sequencing methods for studying chromatin accessibility, chromatin conformation and DNA-binding proteins.
This project builds analytical tools to study tumor heterogeneity and cellular plasticity in thyroid cancer using existing sequencing data from patient samples.
This project builds a network of disease-to-disease relationships so data from genomic and proteomic resources can be linked.
This project tests whether chromosome breakage in cancer cells directly causes changes in DNA methylation and transposon activation.
This project uses laboratory rats to test whether antipsychotic drugs given early in life raise sensitivity to opioid drugs in adulthood.
This project develops artificial intelligence methods that pick out promising research topics for developing therapeutics, learning from past examples of success and failure.
This project studies how mutations in cardiac myosin binding protein C change its structure and function in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
This project sets up an incubator floor with research laboratories where start-up companies and researchers can turn basic research concepts into pilot commercial projects.
This project builds a theoretical framework that simplifies a neural population to find the variables that matter for sensing the environment and driving behavior.
This project studies how two inhibitory receptors work together to limit autoimmune disease, and in which cell types they act.
This project studies T cells in circulation, atherosclerotic lesions and the kidney to understand how cardiovascular disease develops in humans.
